About

I am a senior frontend individual contributor working on enterprise Angular products with TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx and server-side rendering.

I am strongest where product frontend meets platform concerns: authentication migrations, API contracts, controlled rollouts, accessibility, performance and SSR.

Earlier full-stack .NET/C# work from 2018 to 2020 gives me useful backend context without changing the direction of my career: frontend product engineering is the focus.

I also build engineering controls when they solve a delivery problem (automated review, context management and documentation search) but they remain part of the frontend system rather than a separate professional identity.
